# Lucky Store POS Admin API

> Lucky Store internal administration and point-of-sale management system.

## Overview
Lucky Store POS is a private management console for inventory cataloging, sales tracking, stock adjustments, and supplier ledgers.

## Endpoints & Capabilities
- **Inventory Management**: Real-time product inventory tracking, barcode scanning, and bulk batch pricing.
- **Stock Audit & Ledger**: Complete ledger for sales, procurement, and stock audit logging.
- **Point of Sale**: Offline-first POS transaction processing.

## Protocols & Specs
- [Agentic Commerce Protocol](https://agenticcommerce.dev): Discovery available at `/.well-known/acp.json` on the public storefront.
- [Auth.md](https://workos.com/auth.md): Agent authentication and discovery available at `/auth.md`.
